sections.description: Feature comments, sort recipe reviews, and collect reader photos, videos, and helpful votes.
sections.changelog:
= 0.7.0 =
* Add cached suggested discussion topics with synonym matching, distinct-thread thresholds, accessible filtering and resumable background indexing.
* Add independent topic settings and an administrator-only cache-clear action; invalidate suggestions after comment changes and support page-cache adapters.

= 0.6.0 =
* Add a versioned featured-comment template with child-theme, parent-theme and plugin fallback rendering.
* Document portable theme styling, overrides, AJAX contracts and upgrade checks; keep selection and moderation in the plugin.

= 0.5.9 =
* Add debounced AJAX search as readers type, keeping focus and comment drafts intact.
* Keep filter recovery available for empty searches and ignore superseded requests.
* Combine the cache and access work with the existing featured-review and uploader improvements.

= 0.5.8 =
* Place the shared media uploader after comment fields and before submission for visitors and logged-in users.

= 0.5.7 =
* Add native Feature/Unfeature controls beneath approved comments on recipe pages for users with per-comment editing permission. Reuse the protected editorial POST handler; visitors and subscribers see no controls.

= 0.5.6 =
* Add a plain-text `mtt_ch_featured_label` filter for theme-owned editorial badge wording, with escaped output and a Featured fallback.

= 0.5.5 =
* Show approved featured-review photos and video posters through the shared media renderer and accessible viewer. Keep badge customization in theme CSS or WordPress Additional CSS.

= 0.5.4 =
* Highlight editorially featured comments with a Featured badge and a lightly tinted theme-accent card above the first Recommended results. Add an optional featured-background Appearance override.

= 0.5.3 =
* Inset filter dropdown chevrons with reserved text space, RTL support and native high-contrast fallback.

= 0.5.2 =
* Unify public control styling with shared primary, outline and quiet variants, theme branding, visible focus and 44px button targets.
* Add mouse drag and release momentum to reader media; preserve native touch scrolling, reduced motion, keyboard controls and ordinary links.
* Isolate carousel lifecycle and dispose animations, listeners and resize observers before AJAX replacement. Initialize preserved native uploaders only once.

= 0.5.1 =
* Combine photos and video in one FilePond picker, preserving native submission and independent server validation.
* Inherit theme typography and Global Styles, with optional native Appearance settings for colors and corner radius; keep appearance independent of AI.

= 0.5.0 =
* Add whole-thread comment search, rating/media filters, a reader-rating breakdown, and a compact responsive review hub.
* Add moderated short video uploads with bounded local conversion, metadata removal, poster generation, captions, and click-to-play viewing.
* Add a recipe-tips prompt without another required field or checkbox.

= 0.4.1 =
* Replace the gallery disclosure with an always-visible, swipeable photo carousel, cover-photo star ratings, and accessible previous/next controls. Keep review details in the photo viewer.

= 0.4.0 =
* Add a See all photos gallery of approved photo reviews across comment pages, with review excerpts, ratings, and stable links to each thread.
* Add bounded gallery pagination, AJAX enhancement, and previous/next photo controls in the closable viewer.

= 0.3.3 =
* Open review photos in a native modal with a visible Close button, Escape/backdrop dismissal, and focus restoration. Keep standard image links as the no-JavaScript fallback.

= 0.3.2 =
* Remove the recipe-made checkbox and public declaration label to simplify the form. Preserve existing metadata; ratings, recommendations, photo uploads, and subscriptions are unchanged.

= 0.3.1 =
* Use pinned FilePond 4.x with image previews, removable selections, drag-and-drop, and file validation. Bundle MIT-licensed runtime assets locally; preserve native form submission, server validation, moderation, and the no-JavaScript fallback.

= 0.3.0 =
* Add progressive AJAX comment sorting and pagination with crawlable URLs, browser history, draft preservation, and full-page fallbacks.
* Rename the public rating sort to Recommended and add Feather thumbs-up/down votes with change/clear controls.
* Improve the recipe-made field and add bounded, re-encoded photo reviews with native comment moderation and photo removal controls.

= 0.2.0 =
* Default to existing recipe ratings without AI, with chronological fallback on unrated posts and stable thread pagination.
* Add nonce-protected helpful voting with duplicate protection, undo, and rate limiting; votes break ties within star ratings.
* Add an optional reader-declared “I made this recipe” field while preserving provider ratings, schema, and saved AI functionality.

= 0.1.0 =
* Add editorial picks, a single featured card, and thread-aware Recommended/Newest/Oldest ordering.
* Add queued native WordPress AI analysis, monthly reconciliation, and optional local browser analysis with quality gates.
* Preserve legacy featured selections and provide authenticated controls, portable styling, and disposable-site regression coverage.
